recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. No broader core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5801 because the current spec already centralizes Coding.system URI management and links to it; this fix only removes stale terminology that would mislead current implementers.
issue_request: FHIR-5801 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to improve Coding.system URI documentation by pulling system URI management and registration guidance into one section and referring to it from relevant places.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite svn revision 5735, represented by git commit 303df2d0c1100512a5fe007281f494a0fbc7bb62, which added centralized Managing Terminology System URIs guidance in source/terminologies.html and linked Coding.system prose in source/datatypes.html to that section.
additional_context: Current source/datatypes.html still points Coding.system readers to source/terminologies.html#system and separately states that CodeSystem.url is the correct system value. FHIR-7704 and commit db97687e389053bf564912b6ff7ceb3df75ac758 removed the same obsolete inline ValueSet code-system wording from datatypes.html but left the centralized note stale. Later FHIR-50716/TSMG evidence updated URI selection policy toward THO/TSMG without changing the CodeSystem.url rule.
reconciliation: Changed the central Choosing a system note in source/terminologies.html to say that when a code is defined by a CodeSystem resource, the correct Coding.system value is CodeSystem.url, not ValueSet.url.
source_changes: source/terminologies.html: replaced the obsolete ValueSet.codeSystem.system/ValueSet.uri note in the Choosing a system section with current CodeSystem.url/ValueSet.url guidance.

related_jiras.note: Later cleanup removed obsolete ValueSet inline-code-system wording from Coding/datatype guidance, supporting the same correction in the centralized FHIR-5801 section.
Later Vocab decision updated the code system URI lookup list to THO/TSMG policy; it provides current context but does not change the CodeSystem.url correction.
Historical rename from ValueSet.define to ValueSet.codeSystem explains how the obsolete phrase entered the centralized section before current CodeSystem modeling replaced it.
